# Advent of Code Solutions Log

This file is automatically maintained by the problem-solver codebase to track successful solutions generated by LLMs. Entries are only added when a solution is validated against either a successful submission or a known correct answer.

**⚠️ DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE MANUALLY ⚠️**  
All entries are automatically recorded by the solver when solutions are validated.

| Year | Day | Part | Repository Hash | LLM Model(s) | Validation Time (UTC) | Solved By | Solution File |
|------|-----|------|----------------|--------------|----------------------|-----------|---------------|

## File Format Documentation
This file is maintained automatically by the problem-solver codebase. Each solution is recorded only once per year/day/part when first validated. The fields are:

- Year, Day, Part: Problem identifier
- Repository Hash: Full git commit hash of the codebase version used. If there were uncommitted local changes when the solution was validated, this will be indicated with "(modified)" after the hash
- LLM Model(s): Specific model version that generated the successful solution
- Validation Time: UTC timestamp when the solution was validated
- Solved By: GitHub username of the person who validated the solution (obtained from GitHub CLI or email, falls back to git user.name if GitHub identity cannot be determined)
- Solution File: Path to the successful solution file in the solutions directory

The table is updated automatically by `record_solution()` in utils.py when the solver validates a correct solution.
